blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Human Endocrine System) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the path of the chemical message carried by a hormone from the endocrine gland to the target cell. How do hormones differ from neurotransmitters? (4 marks)
(Hormone ke kimiyai paigham ka endocrine gland se target cell tak rasta bayan karein. Hormones neurotransmitters se kaise mukhtalif hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Paigham ka rasta:
1. Endocrine gland (bila duct) makhsoos stimulus milne par hormone kharij karta hai.
2. Hormone khoon (ya tissue fluid) mein jata hai; khoon ise tamam cells tak le jata hai.
3. Har hormone sirf apne target cells par asar karta hai jin mein receptors hote hain; har receptor aik makhsoos hormone se jurta hai.
4. Receptors cell membrane par, cytoplasm mein ya nucleus mein ho sakte hain.
5. Jurne se cell ke andar tabdeeliyan aati hain aur target cell makhsoos jawab deta hai. Is liye hormones ko chemical messengers kehte hain.

Hormones aur neurotransmitters: dono chemical messengers hain, magar hormones endocrine system aur neurotransmitters nervous system ka hissa hain. Hormones aksar dheere asar karte hain magar asar lamba hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Each hormone affects only its target cells

blocks.prompt:
2 Compare peptide and protein hormones with steroid hormones in their chemical nature, solubility, entry into the cell and examples. (4 marks)
(Peptide aur protein hormones ka steroid hormones se kimiyai fitrat, solubility, cell mein dakhle aur misalon mein muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono groups ka farq table mein hai. Peptide hormones membrane se nahi guzarte is liye cell ki satah se asar karte hain, jabke steroids andar ja kar nucleus par asar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Unlike proteins, steroids are lipid-soluble (fat-soluble)

rows: Amino acids ki zanjeeron se bane
Water-soluble; khoon mein aasani se hal
Cell membrane se guzar jate hain
Cell ki satah ke receptors se jurte hain
Seedha nucleus ko hidayat dete hain
Insulin, glucagon (pancreas); growth hormone (anterior pituitary); oxytocin (hypothalamus, posterior pituitary chhorta hai)

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe glycoprotein hormones and amino acid derivative hormones with their sources and functions. (4 marks)
(Glycoprotein hormones aur amino acid derivative hormones ko un ke source aur kaamon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Glycoprotein hormones: conjugated proteins, yani protein ke saath carbohydrate (shakar) group; bare, pecheeda, polar molecules jo membrane se nahi guzarte. Misalein (sab anterior pituitary):
1. TSH: thyroid se thyroxine banwata hai.
2. FSH: sperm banna ya egg ki nashonuma.
3. LH: auraton mein ovulation, mardon mein testosterone.

(ii) Amino acid derivative hormones: aik amino acid (aksar tyrosine ya tryptophan) se bane chhote molecules. Membrane se guzarna is par munhasir hai ke protein jaise hain ya lipid jaise: epinephrine aur norepinephrine nahi guzarte; thyroxine aur tri-iodothyronine guzar jate hain.
1. Epinephrine (adrenal medulla): foran fight or flight.
2. Norepinephrine (adrenal medulla): BP aur chaukasi barhata hai.
3. Thyroxine, T₄ (thyroid): metabolism ki raftar.
4. Triiodothyronine, T₃ (thyroid): jism ki hararat aur dil ki dharkan.

book_ref.quote: So, they also cannot pass through the cell membrane

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the location of the major endocrine glands of the human body, naming one hormone of each. (4 marks)
(Insani jism ke bare endocrine glands ki jagah bayan karein aur har aik ka aik hormone likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hypothalamus: dimagh ka hissa; is ke neurosecretory cells releasing/inhibiting hormones, ADH aur oxytocin banate hain.
2. Pituitary: infundibulum se hypothalamus se jura; misal growth hormone (anterior lobe).
3. Thyroid: titli numa, gardan ke saamne trachea ke dono taraf; thyroxine.
4. Parathyroid: thyroid ki pichli satah par chaar chhote glands; parathormone.
5. Thymus: sternum ke neeche aur lungs ke darmiyan; thymosin.
6. Pancreas: exocrine cells ke darmiyan islets of Langerhans; insulin.
7. Adrenal glands: har gurde ke bilkul oopar; cortisol (cortex), epinephrine (medulla).
8. Gonads: ovaries (estrogen) aur testes (testosterone).

book_ref.quote: The locations of major endocrine glands have been shown below.

blocks.prompt:
5 Name the hormones of the hypothalamus that act on the anterior pituitary and state the effect of each. (4 marks)
(Hypothalamus ke woh hormones jo anterior pituitary par asar karte hain, un ke naam aur asar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells hormones kharij karte hain jo khoon ki naliyon se anterior pituitary tak jate hain. Yeh do qism ke hain: releasing hormones (anterior pituitary ko hormones banane aur kharij karne par ubharte hain) aur inhibiting hormones (rokte hain).

book_ref.quote: Neurosecretory cells of hypothalamus secrete hormones that travel to the anterior pituitary through these blood vessels

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the structure of the pituitary gland and its connections with the hypothalamus. (i) How is it attached and divided? (ii) How are its anterior and posterior lobes linked to the hypothalamus? (4 marks)
(Pituitary gland ki banawat aur hypothalamus se rabte bayan karein. (i) Yeh kaise jura aur taqseem hai? (ii) Is ke anterior aur posterior lobes hypothalamus se kaise jure hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Pituitary gland infundibulum naam ki dandi se hypothalamus se jura hai. Is ke teen lobes hain: anterior, intermediate (median) aur posterior. Insanon mein intermediate pituitary anterior aur posterior ke darmiyan cells ki patli teh hai aur MSH banata hai.

(ii) Anterior lobe: khoon ki naliyan hypothalamus ko anterior pituitary se jorti hain; neurosecretory cells ke releasing aur inhibiting hormones in ke zariye ja kar is ka ikhraj control karte hain.
Posterior lobe: is mein hypothalamus se aane wale axons hain. Neurosecretory cells ke banaye oxytocin aur ADH in axons se aa kar yahan jama hote aur khoon mein chhore jate hain. Yeh khud koi hormone nahi banata. Embryo mein yeh neural tissue ke ubhar se banta hai, is liye dono axons ke tract se jure rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Pituitary gland is divided into three lobes called the anterior pituitary, posterior pituitary and intermediate / median pituitary

blocks.prompt:
7 Many anterior pituitary hormones regulate other endocrine glands. Describe the hormones that act on the thyroid, adrenal cortex and gonads, and state what each does there. (4 marks)
(Anterior pituitary ke kai hormones doosre endocrine glands ko regulate karte hain. Thyroid, adrenal cortex aur gonads par asar karne wale hormones aur un ka kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. TSH (thyrotropin): thyroid se thyroxine banwata hai jo oxidative respiration tez karta hai.
2. ACTH (corticotropin): adrenal cortex se corticosteroids kharij karwata hai jo glucose aur namak ka tawazun regulate karte hain.
3. LH: auraton mein ovaries se progesterone aur estrogen banwata aur ovulation shuru karta hai; mardon mein testes se testosterone banwata hai.
4. FSH: auraton mein ovarian follicles aur mardon mein sperms ki nashonuma.
FSH aur LH dono gonadotropins kehlate hain; in ke asar se gonads sex hormones banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Anterior pituitary secretes many hormones, many of which regulate the activity of other endocrine glands

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the disorders caused by imbalance of growth hormone. Why is GH treatment not suitable for everyone? (4 marks)
(Growth hormone ke bigar se hone wali bimariyan wazeh karein. GH ka ilaj har aik ke liye munasib kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Gigantism: barhte bache mein GH ki zyadti; qad aam se bohat zyada, bare haath, paon aur chehre ke nuqoosh.
2. Acromegaly: baaligh umr mein GH ki zyadti; haddiyan lambai mein nahi barh saktin magar motai mein barhti hain; bare haath, paon, khopri, naak aur jabra.
3. Dwarfism: GH ki kami; nashonuma bohat aahista aur qad chhota, magar hisse mutanasib aur dimagh aur IQ par asar nahi.

GH ilaj: GH ki kami se chhote qad wale bachon ko diya jata hai aur growth barhata hai. Magar har dwarf mein GH ki kami nahi hoti, is liye yeh har aik ke liye munasib nahi. Doctor muscles banane ya burhapa rokne ke liye GH ki himayat nahi karte.

book_ref.quote: If there is an over-secretion of growth hormone (GH) in a growing child, it causes gigantism

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the hormones released by the posterior pituitary and the effects of under-secretion of each. (4 marks)
(Posterior pituitary ke kharij karda hormones aur un ki kami ke asraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Posterior pituitary koi hormone nahi banata; yeh hypothalamus ke banaye do hormones jama aur kharij karta hai.

1. ADH (vasopressin): gurdon mein pani rokwata hai. Kami se diabetes insipidus hota hai: bohat zyada patla peshab aur bar bar pyaas.
2. Oxytocin: mammary glands ke smooth muscles sukerh kar doodh nikalwata aur wiladat mein uterus sukerhta hai. Kami se wiladat ka normal amal rukta hai. Doodh pilane wali maaon mein is ka ikhraj jari rehta hai, is liye un ka uterus jaldi normal size par aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The following are the hormones released by posterior pituitary.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the effects of hypothyroidism, including cretinism, myxoedema and goitre. (4 marks)
(Hypothyroidism ke asraat bayan karein, cretinism, myxoedema aur goitre samait.)
blocks.explanation:
Hypothyroidism thyroid hormones ki kami hai.
1. Aam asraat: growth ka rukna, susti, wazan barhna, qabz, zyada cholesterol, aur dil ki dharkan aur hararat kam.
2. Cretinism: janeen aur bachpan mein hypothyroidism; growth ruk jati aur zehni pasmandgi.
3. Myxoedema: shadeed hypothyroidism; connective tissues mein mucopolysaccharides jama ho kar jild aur tissues sooj kar mote hote hain.
4. Goitre: iodine ki kami se hypothyroidism; thyroid gland ki sujan.

book_ref.quote: Severe hypothyroidism result in is a rare, life-threatening complication known as myxoedema

blocks.prompt:
11 What is hyperthyroidism? Describe Graves' disease and its symptoms. (4 marks)
(Hyperthyroidism kya hai? Graves' disease aur is ki alamaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Hyperthyroidism thyroid hormones ka zyada ikhraj hai (TSH ki zyadti se bhi hota hai). Is se wazan kam, aur BP, dil ki dharkan aur hararat zyada hoti hai.

(ii) Graves' disease aik autoimmune marz hai jo hyperthyroidism aur aksar thyroid ka barhna karta hai. Alamaat: chirchirapan, muscles ki kamzori, neend ke masail, tez dharkan, garmi bardasht na hona, dast, wazan kam hona aur pindli ki jild ka mota hona. Aankhon ka ubharna (exophthalmia) bhi ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Graves’ disease is an autoimmune disease that causes hyperthyroidism

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain how hormones keep the calcium level of blood normal. Mention calcitonin, parathormone and calcitriol. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke hormones khoon mein calcium ki miqdar normal kaise rakhte hain. Calcitonin, parathormone aur calcitriol ka zikr karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Jab khoon ka calcium bohat barh jaye: calcitonin (thyroid) calcium haddiyon mein jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium kam karta hai.
2. Jab calcium gire: parathormone (thyroid ki pichli satah par chaar parathyroid glands) kharij hota hai. Yeh (a) osteoclasts se bone matrix ke calcium crystals ghulwa kar calcium khoon mein chhorta hai, (b) gurdon se peshab ka calcium wapas jazb karwata hai, (c) vitamin D active karta hai jo aant mein calcium jazb karne ke liye zaroori hai.
3. Calcitriol (gurdon ka hormone) aant se calcium jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium barhata hai.

Bigar: parathormone ki zyadti se naram tehri haddiyan aur hypercalcemia (nervous system susti, muscles kamzor); kami se hypocalcaemia, neurons ki tezi aur tetany.

book_ref.quote: It stimulates the osteoclasts (bone cells) to dissolve the calcium crystals of bone matrix

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the actions of insulin and glucagon on blood glucose. (4 marks)
(Insulin aur glucagon ke blood glucose par asraat bayan karein.)

book_ref.quote: It increases the rate of glucose uptake by body cells (e.g., skeletal muscles and fat cells)

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe diabetes mellitus and hypoglycaemia. Compare Type I and Type II diabetes. (4 marks)
(Diabetes mellitus aur hypoglycaemia bayan karein. Type I aur Type II diabetes ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diabetes mellitus (hyperglycaemia): insulin ki kami; cells khoon se glucose nahi le pate, is liye glucose normal se zyada. Zaid glucose gurdon mein pani ka wapas jazb hona rokta hai, zyada peshab, pani ki kami aur gurdon ko nuqsan.

Hypoglycaemia: insulin ki zyadti se glucose normal se kam; alamaat susti, chakkar, ghabrahat aur shadeed haalat mein behoshi.

Diabetes ki qismon ka muqabla table mein hai. Insulin peptide hormone hai, munh se hazam ho jayegi, is liye injection lagta hai; yeh genetically engineered bacteria banate hain.

book_ref.quote: The under secretion of insulin leads to diabetes mellitus (hyperglycaemia) in which cells are unable to obtain glucose from blood

rows: Insulin banane wale β cells nahi hote
Insulin normal, magar cells ki hassasiyat kam
Doosri dawaon, ghiza aur warzish se control

blocks.prompt:
15 Compare glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids. Describe the diseases due to imbalance of cortisol. (4 marks)
(Glucocorticoids aur mineralocorticoids ka muqabla karein. Cortisol ke bigar se hone wali bimariyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Adrenal cortex (adrenal gland ki bahar wali teh, anterior pituitary ke hormones ke control mein) corticosteroids kharij karta hai; muqabla table mein hai.

Cortisol ka bigar:
1. Cushing disease: cortisol ki zyadti, jab pituitary zyada ACTH banaye. Protein ke zyada tootne se zyada sugar, zyada BP, patli haddiyan, muscles ka ghatna, patli nazuk jild, udasi aur auraton mein chehre par zyada baal.
2. Addison's disease: cortisol ki kami; aam metabolic bigar, muscles ki kamzori aur namak ka zaya hona; alamaat aahista aati hain.

book_ref.quote: Glucocorticoids e.g., cortisol and related steroids maintain glucose homeostasis

rows: Muscle protein ko amino acids mein torna jo liver jate hain
Gurde sodium wapas jazb karte hain; saath pani, khoon ki miqdar aur BP normal
Liver mein gluconeogenesis (amino acids se glucose)
Gurde zaid potassium peshab mein nikalte hain

blocks.prompt:
16 Explain the role of the adrenal medulla in the fight or flight response. How is its secretion controlled, and what does its imbalance cause? (4 marks)
(Fight or flight response mein adrenal medulla ka kirdar wazeh karein. Is ka ikhraj kaise control hota hai aur bigar se kya hota hai?)

book_ref.quote: When a person is stressed, the medulla secretes epinephrine and norepinephrine

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the roles of estrogen and progesterone, and the effects of their imbalance. (4 marks)
(Estrogen aur progesterone ke kirdar aur un ke bigar ke asraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Estrogen: FSH ke jawab mein Graafian follicle se. Kaam: secondary sex khususiyaat (chhaatiyon ki nashonuma, pelvis chaura, koolhon aur raanon mein charbi), menstrual cycle ka nizam, menstruation ke baad uterus ki parat ki marammat, ovulation, haddiyon ki kasafat, LDL cholesterol kam, sehatmand BP, aur mood aur yaaddasht.
Bigar: naujawan larkiyon mein kami se jinsi taur par na pakna; baalighon mein banjhpan. Zyadti se fibroids aur polycystic ovaries.

(ii) Progesterone: LH ke jawab mein corpus luteum se, hamal mein placenta se bhi. Mazeed FSH rokta hai (aur follicles nahi pakte), hamal ke liye uterus ki deewar moti aur khoon ki naliyon wali karta hai, aur ovulation dabata hai.
Bigar: menstrual cycle mein kami se hamal ka imkan kam aur jaldi menstruation; hamal mein kami se miscarriage.

book_ref.quote: Its functions include development of secondary sexual characteristics

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the secretion and functions of testosterone. What are the effects of its under-secretion? Name the male changes of puberty. (4 marks)
(Testosterone ka ikhraj aur kaam bayan karein. Is ki kami ke kya asraat hain? Puberty ki mardana tabdeeliyon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ikhraj: LH testes se androgens kharij karwata hai; testosterone aik androgen hai jo seminiferous tubules ke darmiyan interstitial cells banate hain. (Auraton mein bohat thori miqdar, aur adrenal glands bhi thori miqdar banate hain.)

Kaam: mardana reproductive organs ka pakna, secondary sex khususiyaat aur jinsi khwahish, aur normal sperm banne ke liye zaroori.

Kami: zanana khususiyaat aur mardana banjhpan.

Puberty mein mardana tabdeeliyan: sperm banna shuru, awaz bhari, seena chaura aur jism va chehre par baal.

book_ref.quote: It initiates the maturation of male reproductive organs and appearance of secondary sex characteristics and sex drive

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain how hormones of the kidneys, adrenal cortex and posterior pituitary work in water and salt balance and other kidney-related functions. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke gurdon, adrenal cortex aur posterior pituitary ke hormones pani aur namak ke tawazun aur gurdon se mutaliq doosre kaamon mein kaise kaam karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Renin (gurde): adrenal glands mein aldosterone ki paidawar control karta hai.
2. Aldosterone (adrenal cortex): gurdon se sodium wapas jazb karwata hai; saath pani bhi, is tarah khoon ki miqdar aur BP normal. Zaid potassium peshab mein nikalwata hai.
3. ADH (hypothalamus banata, posterior pituitary chhorta): gurdon mein pani rokwata hai; kami se diabetes insipidus (zyada patla peshab, bar bar pyaas).
4. Gurdon ke doosre hormones: erythropoietin bone marrow se RBCs banwata hai; calcitriol aant se calcium jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Kidneys produce renin hormone that controls the production of aldosterone in adrenal glands

blocks.prompt:
20 Define feedback mechanism. Explain positive feedback with the example of oxytocin during childbirth. (4 marks)
(Feedback mechanism ki tareef karein. Wiladat mein oxytocin ki misal se positive feedback wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Feedback mechanism: woh amal jis mein control karne wala nizam khud usi amal ki paidawar se control hota hai.

Positive feedback: control nizam ki paidawar ya jawab us ke amal ko aur tez karta hai.
Misal, wiladat mein oxytocin:
1. Uterus sukerna shuru kare to sensory neurons hypothalamus ko signal bhejte hain.
2. Hypothalamus posterior pituitary se oxytocin chhurwata hai.
3. Oxytocin uterus mein zyada aur taqatwar sukerhaw laata hai.
4. Taqatwar sukerhaw ka paigham milne par hypothalamus mazeed oxytocin chhurwata hai.
5. Yeh silsila bache ki paidaish tak chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxytocin stimulates uterus to produce more and stronger contractions

blocks.prompt:
21 Explain negative feedback in the endocrine system with the examples of insulin and glucagon. (4 marks)
(Insulin aur glucagon ki misalon se endocrine system mein negative feedback wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Negative feedback: aakhri paidawar amal ka pehla qadam rok deti hai. Endocrine system mein yeh aam hai.

(i) Insulin: blood glucose normal se zyada ho to islets ke beta cells insulin chhorte hain. Insulin glucose kam karti hai aur glucose normal ho jata hai. Yeh natija beta cells ko insulin band karne ka ishara deta hai.

(ii) Glucagon: glucose kam ho to alpha cells glucagon chhorte hain jo glucose barhata hai. Glucose normal hone par yeh natija alpha cells ko glucagon band karne ka ishara deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, the release of glucagon is also controlled by negative feedback
